text: Up 0.34% since the open at 730.35, inside the 50% range at N+1 and N+5. The benchmark rose 0.08% and the bank sector fell 0.44%, so neither explains it; residual 0.24%. Two unverified news items first seen since the open (pre-earnings) do not explain it. Open N+1 trade: up 2.15% since entry, above its 80% range.

Down 0.30% since the open at 1383.3, inside the 50% range at N+1 and N+5. The benchmark rose 0.08% and the bank sector fell 0.44%; residual -0.37%. Unverified news items first seen since the open do not account for it. Open trades sit above their 80% range, e.g. up 3.31% since entry at N+3.

Up 2.12% since the open (gap 1.58%), above the 50% range at N+1, inside it at 5 days. NIFTYIT rose 2.05% with residual 0.07%, so the sector accounts for most of it; the benchmark rose 0.08%. Runs against open model down calls. trade with a 5-day horizon: up 11.86% since entry, above its 80% range.

Up 2.33% since the open at 2921.6, above the 50% range at N+1 and N+5. The benchmark rose 0.08% and Autos peers fell 0.35%; residual 2.21%, so the move is mostly stock-specific. One unverified item merely restates M&M up 1.90%. Runs against open down calls; trade with a 5-day horizon up 3.89% since entry, above its 80% range.

Down 0.53% since the open at 1206.4, inside the 50% range at N+1 and N+5. The benchmark rose 0.08% and Energy peers fell 0.41%; residual -0.61%. Unverified items report slips of over 1.5% and 2%, larger than measured. An earnings event is listed for the day. Open N+1 trades up 1.79% since entry, above their 80% range.

Up 2.01% since the open (gap 1.23%), above the 50% range at N+1 and 5 days. NIFTYIT rose 2.05%, sector residual -0.04%, so the sector accounts for it; benchmark rose 0.08%. One unverified item reports IT stocks up to 12%. Runs against open down calls; trade with a 5-day horizon up 11.07% since entry, above its 80% range.

HDFC Bank is down 0.25% since the open at 726.1, inside its 50% 1-day band; the open trade at N+1 is up 1.55% since entry, above its 80% range. Benchmark +0.25% and sector -0.15% leave a small residual of -0.55%. Preview news items are unverified and explain nothing.

Hindalco is up 1.32% since the open at 907.75, above its 50% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.25% and the Metals sector fell 0.44%, so the residual is 1.12%. The only news item (aluminium price, Business Today) is unverified and does not line up. The N+1 trade is up 4.46% since entry, above its 80% range.

ICICI Bank is up 0.54% since the open at 1394.9, inside its 50% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.25% and the Nifty Bank index fell 0.15%, leaving a residual of 0.31%. News items are unverified previews and do not explain it. Open trades at N+1 to N+5 are up 3.93% to 4.17% since entry, above their 80% ranges.

IndiGo is down 2.69% since the open at 4658, below its 50% 1-day band; the move z-score is -1.33. The benchmark rose 0.25%, so the residual is -3.14% and the Transport sector (-0.44%) explains little. Two fall reports, airfare rules (Moneycontrol) and a Business Upturn explainer, are unverified, single-source and first seen since the open.

Infosys is up 2.33% since the open at 1153.75, above its 50% 1-day band, after a 1.58% gap. The benchmark rose 0.25%, but Nifty IT rose 2.41%, leaving a sector residual of -0.08%. The move mostly tracks the IT sector; an IT-rally news item is unverified.

Mahindra & Mahindra is up 2.08% since the open at 2914.6, above its 50% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.25% and Autos 0.22%, so the residual is 1.73% (sector residual 1.87%). Business Upturn's auto-stocks item reports the same gain but is unverified and describes the move rather than explaining it.

Maruti is up 0.22% since the open at 11495, inside its 50% 1-day band. It is in line with the benchmark (+0.25%), residual -0.05%, while Autos rose 2.08%, so it lagged the sector by 1.87%. Maruti news items are unverified (tax tribunal order, a rating note) and do not explain the move.

Reliance is down 0.26% since the open at 1209.7, inside its 50% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.25% and Energy fell 0.54%, so the residual is -0.49%. Share-slip reports (LatestLY, ET Now) are unverified. An earnings event is stored for today; no candidate clearly explains the move.

TCS is up 2.98% since the open at 2449.9, above its 80% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.25% and Nifty IT 2.41%, leaving a sector residual of 0.57%. The move mostly tracks the IT rally; Business Standard on Nifty IT is unverified, as is LatestLY on TCS's quarter.

UltraTech Cement is up 0.62% since the open at 10961, inside its 50% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.25% and Construction fell 0.05%, leaving a residual of 0.31%. The two news items, a live-price page and a Polycab results item, are unverified and unrelated. No candidate explains the move.
